message: Hey Jane, it's Emily here. I was wondering if you could tell me more about the people in our office? I'm trying to get a sense of the social dynamics here. Thanks!

Jane, I need to share something troubling I heard. It's about Tom, Sarah's boyfriend. Apparently, he's been spotted more than once at the company's after-hours gatherings getting overly friendly with Jenna from the marketing department. Eyewitnesses have mentioned seeing them share intimate moments, especially during the last team-building event at O'Malley's Pub on the 5th. This has sparked quite the buzz among the staff. Given our close friendship with Sarah, this puts us in a tough spot. Should we find a way to gently bring this up to Sarah, or maybe observe a bit more before we do anything? I'm torn on the best course of action.
Hi Jane, Emily again. I'm really looking forward to the community event next week. It'll be a great opportunity to meet more people from our social circle!
